notes.title: Post-Release Patch #2
notes.content:
Hello, travelers! 
We felt like Purrgonia was lacking a few things, so we tinkered around a bit and added some stuff!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298060/0a12daa03937ebd6474dba615363b2d14157e8a6.png"]
Change Notes:

Game Start and Dynamics:
Added a Player Guide when pressing "T". Player Guide will show you information about the current mission and direction to it! Moreover, your most recent building progress will be shown there too!

Changed random level generation a bit. Now, if you have a mission you are on, the level generation will allow you to access the quest content if you travel to the correct location. Have a quest in the Plains? Just go there and you will see it! No more going back and forth!

Added level time. When you go to your next raid, you will notice that pressing "T" will show you the clock. The longer you play, the darker it gets (unless it was already dark). It looks kind of pretty, check it out! At the end of the timer, you will be forced to return to the village. Work quickly or you will miss out on the loot!
Other Changes:
Added light and sound effects to loot chests. They are minor, but you will be able to tell the chest is somewhere nearby. At night, you might even see them from far away!

Reworded a few dialogues and highlighted important parts. There were a couple of texts in the game that players found too long, so we adjusted them a bit. 

Added better description for map. Each location now has a name and difficulty associated with it.

Added face light to Eve. She needed to be a little brighter in some cutscenes! 

Added sound to skill/resource equip dialogue to represent selection.

Added a way to summon friends in the village without using the menu. You won't miss it!

And other minor changes. We hope you enjoy it! We hope to see you in Purrgonia or in our next projects!

notes.title: Purrgonia 2.0
notes.content:
Hello, travelers!


Purrgonia has changed for the better! It took us some time and lots of testing, but we are here!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298060/0a12daa03937ebd6474dba615363b2d14157e8a6.png"]

First and foremost, we do recommend going to options in the main menu and resetting your save. Nothing should break with the update but you will get a smoother experience.


Important Additions/Changes: 

Combat
Animations now match the weapons better and long combo chains are possible. You might need to upgrade your stamina to see them all!

Combat is much faster and, thus, hopefully more engaging. Damage and speed are better balanced now.

There are skills that can help in combat. However, you need to figure out how to get them activated! There is even a skill that lets you catch up to the foes running away!

More effects and sounds to make combat pleasing.

Enemies can no longer run away from your playable area. 

Enemies now drop things when they die! No longer they are a menace for no reason!

Different behaviours for enemies. Enemy type and location difficulty will now affect everything starting from them noticing you to how they decide to fight you. No more being chased around the map forever! 

Now you have 9 lives for the duration of the game. You lose a life every time you come back to the village after defeat instead of using a revival stone. I guess it's time to stock up on those, huh? Additional ending included! 

HP bars added! Enjoy seeing the life of your enemies slowly fade away...

More enemy types and bosses! Bandits, ghosts, monsters...

[img src="https://medvedur.com/files/purrgonia/Defeat-Bandit-2.gif"]
World
Even more locations and lore have been added. We are really proud of some of them, so hopefully you will like them too! 

Secret mechanics have been added to spice up the gameplay in different locations. Everything you do affects you in some way. We left a few hints on how the mechanics work in the lore. 

Level boundaries are adjusted so that you do not miss out on any loot. 


Quests/Endings
There is a new building in the village! You can enter it and enjoy a few quests the characters will give you. 

Added rescuable characters. Rescue them and complete their quests. You will not regret it.

Quests will now bring additional two endings to the game that will tie together with the other village endings. 

Endings are much more than just a text now! Your village can even get destroyed completely!

Final boss included! 

Game endings are much more clear now. You will actually get the credits scene this time. You can still play afterward or use New Game Plus. 

Choices and phrasing is a little more sensible in regards to endings. At least we think so.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298060/78fd9b83667b871a7b7cc0c923b3648823e537af.png"]
Village
Village now has a resource mini-game. There are several types of resources: food, wood, metal, gold, and documents. You can find them in the chests or acquire them via other means (no spoilers!)

Resources will affect how happy and healthy your village is. Perhaps, your villagers will reward you for being successful? 

It should be easy to avoid but try not to starve your citizens. Additional ending included! But you don't want it, do ya? 

Each building has a mini-game associated with it! Get rewards and have fun! Sounds like a good deal, eh? 

Your village will now get attacked! Your actions will strongly affect how often and how strongly you the enemies will march on you. Fight alongside your villagers to protect Purrgonia! 
Other
New achievements due to new content! Can you get them all? 

Exploration camera is now shifted to allow better view. Zoom in and zoom out support added.

New Game Plus! Got an ending you don't want? Want to try doing something different? Worry not! New Game Plus is available pretty early in the game and you have a choice for what you want to reset! 

Many other fixes and small additions! Honestly, we can't remember them all! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45298060/46fc9aa524999fb08041f30581a8dbc1ddf9174e.png"]


Roadmap
We are not planning any big additions or changes so far. However, we aim to support the game and fix any bugs you may find. Report them in the discussions, please, it will help out a lot! 

If we do get hit with a big wave of new players...maybe we'll add some stuff in. We left a few developer notes in our files for some potential ideas. As for now, we hope to put in more time and effort into new projects. 

Important! We are considering changing the game price after the Summer Sale 2025 ends. Since the game is in a much better state now, we think the new price of $5 will reflect our project better. You can still buy it at the old price with the discount for the duration of the Summer Sale, so don't miss out! 

This game has been sort of an experiment for us and we want to see how to make/sell games on Steam in the future. We got plenty of ideas and we'd love for you to stay with us for this journey! 



Thank you, dear players! Long live Purrgonia!

notes.title: Post-Release Patch #1
notes.content:
Hello, dear players! We got a quick patch here for you!

What we did:

 New tutorial dialogues to help new players jump in the game
 You may now return to the village in an immersive way (because menus are not fun!)
 Fix some dialogue/lore cameras
 Fix some level design issues (texture holes, invisible walls, etc.)
 A little bit more lore added

notes.title: Release Update
notes.content:
Hey there, explorers!

We're happy to release a new update to Purrgonia!

We worked with plenty of feedback from out beta testers and added much more content to the game!


Now you can find a lot of lore in your travels as well as make choices that will change the ending of the game. 
Can you connect all the dots and get the True Ending?

The game is also now released to the public, so we hope you like it! Let us know what you think in the discussions!
